body.head: List of post offices in Canada, with the names of the postmasters ... 1856 / With a supplementary list to 1st March, 1857, inclusive
body.author: Canada. Post Office Department
body.p: Transcriber’s Note: A large number of obvious printer’s errors have been corrected, mostly around punctuation and accents, but more or less no attempt has been made to standardise the varying spelling of the names of people and places.
body.head:
LIST
OF
POST OFFICES
IN
CANADA,
WITH THE
NAMES OF THE POSTMASTERS,
ON
THE 1st SEPTEMBER, 1856.
body.subtitle:
WITH A SUPPLEMENTARY LIST TO 1st MARCH, 1857,
INCLUSIVE.

p.hi: PRINTED BY ORDER OF THE POSTMASTER GENERAL.

body.p:
TORONTO:
PRINTED BY LOVELL AND GIBSON, YONGE STREET,
1856.

Postmasters will correct their Lists by the Notices of Post Office Operations, with which they will be furnished from time to time; and should any Postmaster discover an error in the description of his Office, as set forth in this List, he will please notify the same to this Department.

p.hi: The Offices whose names are printed in Italics are authorized to grant and pay Money Orders.
